title: Ocean Fresh Irish Cauliflower Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful pescatarian-friendly stew featuring cauliflower and a hint of mustard, perfect for a rainy day. This monsoon-inspired Irish dish is aerated with a touch of candy sweetness.
instructions: In a large pot, saute the chopped onion and carrot in a little bit of oil over medium heat until they are tender.
Add the chopped potato and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cauliflower florets and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the cod pieces and cook until they are opaque and flake easily with a fork, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the whole-grain mustard and crushed peppermint candies.
Pour in the low-sodium chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 10-15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew until it is slightly aerated, or leave it chunky if desired.
Stir in the heavy cream, if using, and season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives if desired.
